appears_on.role: The statutory fund that ran the project through its Project Implementation Unit, carried out the two evaluations of the vendors' losses and prepared the abbreviated action plan. The plan says the first contractor's works contract was terminated prematurely in September 2013. Channel 5 Belize reported on 30 January 2014 that work stopped amid allegations of an incompetent contractor and corruption at the fund, and Amandala reported on 4 April 2014 that four fund employees were dismissed after the first contractor alleged extortion in September 2013, and that the employees denied the claims.

appears_on.case_title: Twenty Dangriga Market Vendors Were Moved Out for Twenty-Six Months and Lost a Quarter of Their Income

appears_on.role: The town council, which sought the funding to expand the market, put up three per cent of the sub-project cost, housed the displaced cooked-food and meat vendors in the renovated slaughterhouse and paid their utilities there, and operates the one-stall-per-family policy that the plan says affects five families, who are to be compensated with temporary stalls beside the Cubanos area. The plan says the council agreed to meet 14,990.68 Belize dollars of utility costs and 24,530.00 in stall-fee arrears for all the temporarily relocated vendors.

appears_on.case_title: Twenty Dangriga Market Vendors Were Moved Out for Twenty-Six Months and Lost a Quarter of Their Income

The plan says his contract was terminated prematurely in September 2013 after works that had run from June 2012, and that during his tenure job openings for Dangriga residents were very limited, with more than 75 per cent of workers coming from outside the Stann Creek District. Channel 5 Belize reported on 23 October 2014 that he had been paid about 800,000 Belize dollars before work stopped.

appears_on.case_title: Twenty Dangriga Market Vendors Were Moved Out for Twenty-Six Months and Lost a Quarter of Their Income

The plan says civil works resumed in April 2014, and that in July 2014 about 12 of a workforce of 17 were Dangriga residents.
